checks.q: Is the VRF subscription adequately funded to prevent request failures?
Is the VRF callback function protected against revert attacks?
Is the callback gas limit set high enough for all execution paths?
Is the request ID properly mapped to prevent result confusion?
Are VRF results used exactly once to prevent replay?
Is the block confirmation count set appropriately to prevent reorg attacks?
Is the VRF coordinator address verified against the official deployment?
